source_note: RB03 (ADR-019): constants for the challenge runner, solver, difficulty score and pillar checks, read by reference/lbo_challenge.py and scripts/simulation/challenge_runner.gd. Ticks are the 10 Hz grid tick. action_ticks is the time one player action costs (switch, cable, start/stop, climb), a human-speed pace; carry_ticks is moving the temporary supply between anchors; wait_limit_ticks caps one wait-for-a-condition step. crew_work_pct is the default crew scaling copied into a challenge: repair work and carrying take that percentage of the solo time with 1-4 players (more hands, same answer). Weights and tier thresholds are DESIGN CHOICES calibrated on C01-C12 in RB03 (docs/evidence/RB03.md); whether the tiers feel right needs people (D07/B studies).
